name: Claudio's
description: A big waterfront restaurant, bar and marina on Greenport Harbor known for seafood and an open-air deck. Live bands play Friday through Sunday in season, and DJs take over late on Friday and Saturday nights.

dancing.notes: The venue itself advertises late-night DJs and dancing under the harbor lights on Fridays and Saturdays. A visitor review also describes people dancing to the live band at the outdoor wharf bar. Expect a crowded, party-style outdoor space rather than a formal dance floor.

evidence.note: Home page says Friday and Saturday late nights bring DJs, theme parties and dancing under the harbor lights.
Music page says live bands play the waterfront every Friday through Sunday, plus golden-hour sets and late-night DJs.
Older visitor review says the live music at the outdoor waterfront bar brought out lots of dancers and singers.
